# Technobotics

> > Technobotics is a Mumbai-based STEM education provider offering hands-on robotics and coding courses using Arduino, Android, and IoT technologies for students of all skill levels.

Technobotics specializes in practical robotics and STEM education in Mumbai, combining Arduino programming, Android app development, and electronics training with a focus on autonomous robotics and real-world applications. The organization emphasizes hands-on learning and community engagement through both formal courses and CSR initiatives.

## Key Topics

- STEM Education
- Robotics Courses
- Arduino Programming
- Android Development
